name: Cedar Lake (United States)
description: White field with a blue outline map of the town bearing a white sailboat and the date 1836, a green cedar tree on either side, and yellow scrolls reading Where Hoosier Hospitality Starts above and Cedar Lake, Indiana below.
history: Cedar Lake is a town in Lake County, Indiana. The flag is prescribed in the town's municipal code (§ 12.02 Town flag), which sets its dimensions at three by five feet.
